description: Membuat gambar QR code (SVG) dari teks QRIS yang valid. Renders a valid QRIS payload as an SVG QR code (byte mode, error correction L/M/Q/H, default M). Built-in encoder, no dependencies, offline. Refuses invalid QRIS. Always test-scan the result before printing.

module_px.description: Pixels per module (width/height attributes only; the SVG scales).

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

name: qris_to_svg
title: QRIS ke gambar SVG / QRIS to SVG
